# 3D scene library

> **Status:** 3 environments and 4 conditions; 6 of 12 looks are used by a scene. The analysis export never reads the library. Fields the viewer never reads: `environment.ground2`. Picture only: **a look never changes a run**.

## Purpose

The environments (ground, sky and grid colours, how far the ground is drawn) and conditions (sun, ambient light, fog, sky tint) the 3D scenes are dressed in. A scene names one of each; a variant swaps only the look. The look is kept out of the analysis so a foggy replay of a run is the same run.

| field | `#8a9b62` | `#cde0f2` | `#6a7a48` | 160 m |

| Condition | Sun | Ambient | Fog | Sky tint |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| overcast | 0.45 | 0.8 | — | `#c4ccd4` |
| dusk | 0.35 | 0.45 | — | `#4a5578` |
| fog | 0.4 | 0.85 | 70 m | `#d7dde2` |

## Boundary diagram

![Figure 4 · Boundary diagram](assets/sim/scenes3d/library/figures/fig-4-boundary-diagram.svg)

| # | From | To | Crossing / interaction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Scene definitions | Look library | each scene names an environment and a condition |
| 2 | Look library | Page builder | the named look, embedded in the page |
| 3 | Page builder | Viewer | ground, sky, grid, extent, sun, ambient, fog, tint |
| 4 | Analysis export | Scene definitions | motion only; never reads the library |
| 5 | CI | Look library | test_scenes3d.py: a look never changes the analysis |

**Explicitly excluded:** anything that affects a run (dynamics, timing, outcome), the camera presets (in `viewer.js`) and the rendering itself.

## Adding a look

1. Add an environment or condition to its file; keep it picture only.
2. Name it in a scene's `look` or a variant in [`scenes.yaml`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/sim/scenes3d/scenes.yaml), rebuild the pages and render the stills (see [`sim/scenes3d`](3D-Scene-Builder)).
3. Regenerate this page and run the full check list in [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/jherrodthomas/Project-Susanoo/blob/main/CLAUDE.md).
